## Run 6 — electron SdH spot check, B_1–B_2

Step 3 of `hera_scratch/plan.md`: with the run-5 A-ridge calibration, the
hardwired pair was measured at A n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D=0, B=0→10 T. The raw
sr1 X and drain current appear first below; the resistance and windowed SdH
spectrum follow. The frequency in one fixed-density trace is a preview of
pockets and harmonics, not a stacking verdict.

from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset
g6 = run(6)
ch6 = resolve_channels(g6.meta)
ic6 = current_channel(ch6)
vc6 = next(ch for ch in ch6 if ch.cid == 'sr1')
B6 = g6.col('magnet_field')
I6 = g6.col(ic6.col) / ic6.gain
V6 = g6.col(vc6.col) / vc6.gain
R6 = np.abs(V6 / I6)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.5))
ax[0].plot(B6, V6*1e6, '.', ms=1.5); ax[0].set_ylabel('raw sr1 X (µV)')
ax[1].plot(B6, I6*1e9, '.', ms=1.5); ax[1].set_ylabel('raw drain I (nA)')
for a in ax: a.set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.suptitle('run 6 raw channels — B_1–B_2, A n=+3.2e12, D=0'); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.5))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=.8); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)',title='run 6 |V/I|')
for lo, color in [(2,'C0'),(3,'C1'),(4,'C2')]:
    ff, spec = sdh_fft(R6[:,None], B6, b_range=(lo,9.8), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    m = (ff>=2)&(ff<=45); yy=spec[0,m]
    ax[1].plot(ff[m], yy/yy.max(), color=color, label=f'{lo}–9.8 T')
    pk,_=find_peaks(yy, prominence=.1); top=sorted(pk,key=lambda p: yy[p],reverse=True)[:4]
    print(f'FFT {lo}–9.8 T:', [(round(float(ff[m][p]),1),round(float(yy[p]/yy.max()),2)) for p in top])
ax[1].set(xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT',title='window-dependent spectrum'); ax[1].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('R range/median Ω:',R6.min(),np.median(R6),R6.max(),'I nA:',np.min(I6)*1e9,np.median(I6)*1e9,np.max(I6)*1e9)
print('T range K:',np.min(g6.col('T_sample')),np.max(g6.col('T_sample')))
print('gate max |I| pA:',max(abs(g6.col('k_2400_tg_curr')))*1e12,max(abs(g6.col('k_2400_bg_curr')))*1e12)
print(sdh_onset(R6,B6,b_lo=.3,b_hi=10,r_full_scale=5000).summary())

**Read (run 6):** The record is complete (921/921 field points). Drain current
stays 9.843–9.935 nA, |Rxx| reaches 530 Ω, both gate currents stay below
124 pA, and T_sample is 1.165–1.292 K. Oscillations are clear. The 2–9.8 T
FFT has a 5.0 T low-frequency feature plus 15.1, 22.6, and 30.1 T peaks;
above 3 T the ~30 T feature dominates, and above 4 T it shifts to 33.8 T as
the window narrows. The onset helper tracks a 7.1 T tone down to its 0.3 T
record edge (censored) and warns that several higher peaks can be harmonics.
These numbers establish a fan is worthwhile, but do not distinguish ABAB
pockets from harmonics or the offset second ridge in run 5.

## Run 7 — hole SdH spot check, B_1–B_2

Step 3 of `hera_scratch/plan.md`: the same pair was measured at A
n=−1.2×10¹² cm⁻², D=0 while B rode down 10→0.3 T. The raw voltage and
current appear first below; resistance and windowed SdH spectrum follow.
This result tests the original expectation that the hole side would be
thermally suppressed at the VTI's electron temperature.

from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset
g7 = run(7)
ch7 = resolve_channels(g7.meta)
ic7 = current_channel(ch7)
vc7 = next(ch for ch in ch7 if ch.cid == 'sr1')
B7 = g7.col('magnet_field')
I7 = g7.col(ic7.col) / ic7.gain
V7 = g7.col(vc7.col) / vc7.gain
R7 = np.abs(V7 / I7)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.5))
ax[0].plot(B7, V7*1e6, '.', ms=1.5); ax[0].set_ylabel('raw sr1 X (µV)')
ax[1].plot(B7, I7*1e9, '.', ms=1.5); ax[1].set_ylabel('raw drain I (nA)')
for a in ax: a.set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.suptitle('run 7 raw channels — B_1–B_2, A n=−1.2e12, D=0'); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.5))
ax[0].plot(B7, R7, lw=.8); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)',title='run 7 |V/I|')
for lo, color in [(2,'C0'),(3,'C1'),(4,'C2')]:
    ff, spec = sdh_fft(R7[:,None], B7, b_range=(lo,9.8), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    m = (ff>=2)&(ff<=45); yy=spec[0,m]
    ax[1].plot(ff[m], yy/yy.max(), color=color, label=f'{lo}–9.8 T')
    pk,_=find_peaks(yy, prominence=.1); top=sorted(pk,key=lambda p: yy[p],reverse=True)[:4]
    print(f'FFT {lo}–9.8 T:', [(round(float(ff[m][p]),1),round(float(yy[p]/yy.max()),2)) for p in top])
ax[1].set(xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT',title='window-dependent spectrum'); ax[1].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('R range/median Ω:',R7.min(),np.median(R7),R7.max(),'I nA:',np.min(I7)*1e9,np.median(I7)*1e9,np.max(I7)*1e9)
print('T range K:',np.min(g7.col('T_sample')),np.max(g7.col('T_sample')))
print('gate max |I| pA:',max(abs(g7.col('k_2400_tg_curr')))*1e12,max(abs(g7.col('k_2400_bg_curr')))*1e12)
print(sdh_onset(R7,B7,b_lo=.3,b_hi=10,r_full_scale=5000).summary())

**Read (run 7):** The record is complete (486/486 points). Drain current stays
9.809–9.931 nA, |Rxx| reaches 587 Ω, both gate currents stay below 216 pA,
and T_sample is 1.175–1.291 K. The hole side oscillates strongly: FFT peaks
near 5.0 and 12.6 T in 2–9.8 T, with ~13.0 T dominating 3–9.8 T; the onset
helper tracks several tones below 2 T. Thus the earlier thermal-null
expectation was wrong. Window dependence and harmonics prevent a stacking call
from this trace alone. The fan should include the hole side within the
committed TG limit.
